??? quote "Dialogue"

    - There's my fox-catcher. I wiped that one off the board myself. Felt good.
    - Torva says you've been reading my board. Good. Most folk only read the bits that frighten them.
    - What'll it be? Stew, a room, or something I've heard?
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* The board by the door?
        - *Choice:* You and Brodie?
        - *Choice:* Goodbye.
    - Bethoc. I was born in the room over the kitchen. My father Malcolm kept the Gap Inn thirty-five years, and it's been mine these eleven. The old ones still call it Malcolm's. I let them.
    - Sailors, hunters, drovers, travellers, they all end up here sooner or later. And they all tell me things. I've never known why.
    - Five years ago I got tired of hunters arguing over where a beast was seen and by whom. So I nailed a plank by the door and chalked it: what, where, when and who said so. The hunters read it every morning.
    - I wipe it once a month and keep a tally in a book under the bar. Each year the book wants more pages. That's the part that keeps me up. If you want work off it, the board's there. It's always there.
    - Brodie comes in every night after market and sits at the end of the bar till I've time for him. Three years now. The whole market has opinions. I have stew to stir.
    - Mind the step on your way out. Everyone forgets the step.
